order: ascending source number; odd AB, even BA; 6 each
primary: whole-source correctness within the provisional scoring contract, denominator 12 per arm
selectionRule: All 24 determinate, comparable scores, no per-source risk regression, no candidate Severe/Forbidden, and any strict whole-source gain -> DEVELOPMENT_IMPROVEMENT_OBSERVED. It is not an independent quality or deployment pass. Otherwise report incomplete, incomparable, risk regression, targeted fixes or no gain as applicable.
outputInspection: Human reviewer separately checks unsupported titles/descriptions and possible teaching-example leakage before any broader quality claim. Missing reviewer means NOT_ADJUDICATED, not zero leakage.
failurePolicy: transport, parse, schema, reference, semantic, reference dispute and measurement errors reported separately; retain all 24 denominator slots; uncertain sending/billing stops batch
engineeringGate: source/database isolation and safe persistence; independent of comparative model score
independentHoldout: requires unseen materials plus real independent A/B annotators
